response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, demonstrated leadership in AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling, and deep exposure to cloud platforms and data systems — but lacks explicit evidence of 8+ years building production-grade AI solutions, direct RAG/vector DB implementation, or formal technical leadership in enterprise GenAI deployments, which are core to the role.
strengths: Hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling at re:cinq
Proven ability to lead cross-functional technical projects and build scalable cloud systems (AWS, Kubernetes)
Strong track record of open-source contributions and technical mentorship through workshops and frameworks
concerns: No clear documentation of 8+ years focused on production-grade AI/GenAI systems; most AI experience is recent
Missing explicit experience with vector databases, RAG architectures, or LLM evaluation/observability pipelines
Limited evidence of enterprise customer-facing technical leadership or consulting in GenAI cloud delivery

key_factors.factor: Lack of Proven GenAI Production Track Record
